program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = 9.8; const height = launchSpeed * time - 0.5 * gravity * time * time; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * time; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const scaleY = 40; const baseY = 360; const ballY = baseY - height * scaleY; const ballX = 320; let motionText = "Moving up"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionText = "Still for an instant"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionText = "Moving down"; } const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Vertical Toss", state: "Time: " + sdk.format(time, 2) + " s" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 120, y: 360, length: 300, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.5, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("mark.launch", ballX, baseY, 60, "Launch")); objects.push(sdk.line("line.guide", 110, baseY - apexHeight * scaleY, 130, baseY - apexHeight * scaleY, { role: "observed" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "input" })); if (Math.abs(velocity) >= 0.05) { objects.push(sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 25, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); } objects.push(sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 25, y: ballY }, { value: -gravity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 5, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); const calloutLines = [motionText, "Gravity pulls down"]; objects.push(sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, calloutLines, { id: "callout.toss" })); const quantities = { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height }; const readouts = [{ id: "motionState", value: motionText }, { id: "gravityState", value: "Gravity pulls down" }]; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: readouts }, quantities: quantities }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls it downward.
manifest.description: A ball moves vertically on a height scale. A blue motion arrow shows its velocity while a dashed warm gravity arrow remains constant. A callout beside the ball describes its current motion state.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
